item.title: The best way to protect giant sequoias may be more fire
item.description: Giant sequoias are adapted to normal fires, but recent extreme wildfires have killed thousands of trees that survived for centuries.

item.title: Scientists trace the surprising origin of human eyes to an ancient 'cyclops'
item.description: Researchers say a tiny one-eyed ancestor from nearly 600 million years ago may have shaped the evolution of every vertebrate eye, including ours.
